bike.name: 9.0 · MY2011
bike.lede: The aluminium Speedmax: Canyon's aero-era geometry and carbon fork on a 7005 alloy frame, at a fraction of the carbon bike's price.
bike.story: Launched alongside the first carbon Speedmax at Eurobike 2008, the Speedmax AL carried the same adjustable-seat-angle geometry (75° or 78°) and sliding dropouts (380-395 mm chainstays) in 7005 aluminium with an AeroShape tubeset. It stayed in the range until MY2013.
spec: Canyon New F8 Technology · 7005 Ultralight Aluminium, AeroShape, multi-butted
SRAM Force · SL 1090 R2C Aero shifters · SRAM TT Carbon levers
Profile Aris stem · Profile T2 base bar / T2 Wing
bike.method: Scale comes from circle fits to both tyres in Canyon's archived side photo. Every tube is a traced centreline with its side-view depth measured from the photo; widths across the bike are inferred. Parts are rebuilt from the archived specification.
uncertainties: Scale 2.500 mm per pixel from tyre fits; measured wheelbase 990 mm.
Single 740 px side photograph: 2.49 mm per pixel.
Front tyre images 1.7% larger than the rear (studio perspective); scale uses their average.
Frame size: wheelbase fits S (980-995 mm) and stack fits M; recorded as M with S not excluded.
Lateral tube widths, stay spread and fork crown width are inferred; the photo fixes side-view shapes only.
Components are simplified external forms rebuilt from the published specification; hidden mechanisms are not modelled.
Graphics use DIN Condensed Bold in place of Canyon's lettering; positions and sizes traced from the photo.
Cable routing is traced where visible; hidden runs are not modelled.
